description: Open /home/ga/Documents/batch_synthesis_report.odt. Locate the placeholder text '[INSERT YIELD DATA HERE]' in Section 3.0. Delete the placeholder and insert a LibreOffice Calc Spreadsheet Object (OLE Object) in its place. Inside the embedded spreadsheet, create a table with headers 'Batch ID', 'Input Mass (kg)', 'Output Mass (kg)', and 'Yield %'. Enter the following data: Batch A (Input: 50.0, Output: 42.5), Batch B (Input: 48.5, Output: 39.2), Batch C (Input: 52.0, Output: 49.8). In the 'Yield %' column, use a formula to calculate the percentage yield (Output / Input * 100) for each row. Format the 'Yield %' cells to display exactly 1 decimal place. Resize the object frame so the data is clearly visible. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/batch_synthesis_report_complete.odt.
